Delivery method

From operational problem to stable system.

Every Hamerkop implementation moves through a governed path that connects the business requirement to architecture, implementation, go-live and continuous improvement.

  1. 01

    Discover

    Current processes, systems, risks, reporting needs and applicable obligations are mapped at the start of the engagement.

  2. 02

    Design

    Modules, integrations, controls, data flows, workflows and milestones are defined around the agreed scope.

  3. 03

    Implement

    Configuration, customization, integration and data migration move through workflow testing and user training.

  4. 04

    Stabilize & Improve

    Go-live is followed by early operational support, issue resolution, system health reviews and continuous improvement.

Supported beyond go-live

A system ready for day-to-day operation, and able to improve as the institution evolves.
